params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$baseRaw = (& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker inspect heaven-worker-01 | Out-String)
$burstRaw = (& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker inspect heaven-worker-05 | Out-String)
$base = ($baseRaw | ConvertFrom-Json)[0]
$burst = ($burstRaw | ConvertFrom-Json)[0]
[pscustomobject]@{
  base=[pscustomobject]@{
    name=$base.Name
    state=$base.State.Status
    health=$base.State.Health.Status
    nano_cpus=$base.HostConfig.NanoCpus
    memory_bytes=$base.HostConfig.Memory
    pids=$base.HostConfig.PidsLimit
    ports=$base.NetworkSettings.Ports
  }
  burst=[pscustomobject]@{
    name=$burst.Name
    state=$burst.State.Status
    nano_cpus=$burst.HostConfig.NanoCpus
    memory_bytes=$burst.HostConfig.Memory
    pids=$burst.HostConfig.PidsLimit
  }
  base_running=((& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker ps --filter label=heaven.tier=base --format '{{.Names}}' | Measure-Object -Line).Lines)
  burst_running=((& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker ps --filter label=heaven.tier=burst --format '{{.Names}}' | Measure-Object -Line).Lines)
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress
exit 0
